items.title: associateLocationsWithSalesChannelsStep
items.description: This step creates links between stock locations and sales channel records.

items.title: associateProductsWithSalesChannelsStep
items.description: This step creates links between products and sales channel records.

items.title: canDeleteSalesChannelsOrThrowStep
items.description:
This step validates that the specified sales channels can be deleted.
If any of the sales channels are default sales channels for a store, 
the step will throw an error.

items.title: createDefaultSalesChannelStep
items.description:
This step creates a default sales channel if none exist in the application. 
This is useful when creating seed scripts.

items.title: createSalesChannelsStep
items.description: This step creates one or more sales channels.

items.title: deleteSalesChannelsStep
items.description: This step deletes one or more sales channels.

items.title: detachLocationsFromSalesChannelsStep
items.description: This step dismisses links between stock location and sales channel records.

items.title: detachProductsFromSalesChannelsStep
items.description: This step dismisses links between product and sales channel records.

items.title: updateSalesChannelsStep
items.description: This step updates sales channels matching the specified filters.
